notes.title: Sargon7 now available for playtest!
notes.content: Finally we have a new character in the game for playtesting. You can try Sargon7, the CEO of Megacorp himself.

notes.title: Game design enhancements
notes.content:
Update includes:
- Game reset secret shortcut
- Exhibition mode
- Autorun while the opponent is respawning

notes.title: Speed running Event. Speed run mode is now available.
notes.content:
We're thrilled to announce the release of our latest update, featuring an exhilarating Speedrunning Event with a reward that you won't want to miss – a full game Steam Key!

As we gear up for the weekend, we're eagerly preparing for a competition that promises to be filled with high energy and rapid-fire action. We can't wait to witness the display of skills, strategy, and speed that you will bring to the game.

Stay tuned to the discord for further details about this event. 

Thank you for being part of our community.
https://discord.com/invite/nY344mmWZR

notes.title: Indie Fighting Games Fest is coming and Resistance 204X will be there
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/NlsqIaE.jpg[/img]
The Indie Fighting Games Fest is a five-day online celebration of fighting games created by independent developers and small teams.

Many of these games will run discounts or demos. 
The event will happen the weekend of April 13-17.
